commands: set -e; EXPECTED=c2c78c22b5dac294ef7c54c6c79dc9c5fafe3eb5; ACTUAL=$(git rev-parse HEAD); REMOTE=$(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/work/phase1-live-call-probes | awk '{print $1}'); echo expected=$EXPECTED actual=$ACTUAL remote=$REMOTE; test "$ACTUAL" = "$EXPECTED"; test "$REMOTE" = "$EXPECTED"; PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m unittest scripts/test_s22_call_control.py; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state | grep -qx device; STATE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1); echo initial_call_state=$STATE; test "$STATE" = "0"; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" dump-ui >/tmp/phase1c_idle_ui.xml; grep -q '<hierarchy' /tmp/phase1c_idle_ui.xml; rm -f /tmp/phase1c_idle_ui.xml; APK=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge | cut -d: -f2 | head -n1); test -n "$APK"; printf '%s' "$APK" >/tmp/phase1c_apk_path; echo ui_dump_validation=success

set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; cleanup(){ python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }; trap cleanup EXIT; rm -f /tmp/phase1c_ref.wav; echo '=== REFERENCE CALL: NETWORK DTMF 1 ==='; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" dial 510100100; OFF=0; for i in $(seq 1 50); do ST=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1); echo ref_call_state=$ST; if [ "$ST" = "2" ]; then OFF=1; break; fi; sleep 0.4; done; test "$OFF" = "1"; sleep 6; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" dtmf 1; sleep 0.35; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" capture 2000 /tmp/phase1c_ref.wav; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup; trap - EXIT; sleep 1; ST=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1); echo after_ref_state=$ST; test "$ST" = "0"; test -s /tmp/phase1c_ref.wav

set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; APK=$(cat /tmp/phase1c_apk_path); cleanup(){ python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }; trap cleanup EXIT; rm -f /tmp/phase1c_pcm.wav; echo '=== TEST CALL: PCM DTMF 1 VIA CALL_ASSISTANT ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" dial 510100100; OFF=0; for i in $(seq 1 50); do ST=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1); echo pcm_call_state=$ST; if [ "$ST" = "2" ]; then OFF=1; break; fi; sleep 0.4; done; test "$OFF" = "1"; sleep 6; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.CallAssistantAudioProbe play-dual-tone 16000 300 697 1209 0.10"; sleep 0.35; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" capture 2000 /tmp/phase1c_pcm.wav; echo '=== FOCUSED TX LOGCAT ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v brief | grep -i -E 'CALL_ASSISTANT|incall_music|TELEPHONY_TX|getOutputForAttr|AudioTrack' | tail -n 160 || true; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup; trap - EXIT; sleep 1; ST=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1); echo after_pcm_state=$ST; test "$ST" = "0"; test -s /tmp/phase1c_pcm.wav

set -e; echo '=== WAV METRICS ==='; python3 -c 'import hashlib,math,struct,wave; load=lambda p:(lambda w:(w.getframerate(),w.getnchannels(),w.readframes(w.getnframes())))(wave.open(p,"rb")); ra,ca,a=load("/tmp/phase1c_ref.wav"); rb,cb,b=load("/tmp/phase1c_pcm.wav"); sa=struct.unpack("<%dh"%(len(a)//2),a); sb=struct.unpack("<%dh"%(len(b)//2),b); rms=lambda s: math.sqrt(sum(x*x for x in s)/max(1,len(s))); print("ref_rate=%d ref_channels=%d ref_bytes=%d ref_sha256=%s ref_rms=%.2f"%(ra,ca,len(a),hashlib.sha256(a).hexdigest(),rms(sa))); print("pcm_rate=%d pcm_channels=%d pcm_bytes=%d pcm_sha256=%s pcm_rms=%.2f"%(rb,cb,len(b),hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),rms(sb))); n=min(len(sa),len(sb)); print("aligned_mean_abs_diff=%.2f"%(sum(abs(sa[i]-sb[i]) for i in range(n))/max(1,n)))'; echo '=== REFERENCE TRANSCRIPT ==='; swift scripts/transcribe_audio.swift --locale pl-PL /tmp/phase1c_ref.wav || true; echo '=== PCM TRANSCRIPT ==='; swift scripts/transcribe_audio.swift --locale pl-PL /tmp/phase1c_pcm.wav || true; rm -f /tmp/phase1c_ref.wav /tmp/phase1c_pcm.wav /tmp/phase1c_apk_path; echo phase1c_remote_dtmf_reference_vs_pcm_complete=true
